key_facts: Project: DocxGen — AI-powered .docx document generator for Russian-language business documents
Pipeline: User text → AI (Typst markup) → Typst compile → Pandoc convert → .docx download
Stack: React 19 + Vite + Tailwind v4 (frontend), Express + TypeScript (backend), OpenCode API (AI), Typst + Pandoc (doc generation)
spec/ contains 4 document categories with 16 .txt examples and 8 .docx templates
4 categories: Письма (Letters), Протокол совещания (Meeting Protocols), Деловая переписка (Business Correspondence), Экономический отдел (Economic Department reports)

Each category has 4 examples showing the SAME content at 4 formality levels: _1 = fully formal (structured fields + formal language), _2 = semi-formal (casual greetings + some abbreviations), _3 = minimal (fewer fields, concise), _4 = narrative (plain paragraph, no fields)
All examples are structured-field documents with: Кому (To), От кого (From), Дата (Date), Номер (Number), Заголовок (Subject), body text, Подпись (Signature)

The AI prompt (prompts.ts) explicitly requires Russian typographic conventions (em-dashes, «» quotes, non-breaking spaces), formal professional language, and Russian output regardless of input language
example-input.md shows a Q3 2026 financial report with tables, metrics, and structured sections — the kind of content the system is designed to format
call_chains: Frontend (React) → POST /api/generate { text } → Backend (Express) → AIService (OpenCode API big-pickle) → TypstService (typst compile .typ → .pdf) → PandocService (pandoc .typ → .docx) → serve .docx for download

data.for_teamlead: CONTEXT DELIVERED. DocxGen is an AI-powered .docx document generator for Russian business documents. The pipeline takes user text → AI generates Typst markup → Typst compiles to PDF → Pandoc converts to .docx. The spec/ directory contains 4 document categories (Letters, Meeting Protocols, Business Correspondence, Economic Department reports) with 16 text examples showing 4 formality levels per category: _1 = fully formal with structured fields, _2 = semi-formal casual, _3 = minimal concise, _4 = narrative paragraph. All documents follow a structured-field format (To/From/Date/Number/Subject/Body/Signature). The AI prompt enforces Russian typographic conventions and formal professional language. The example-input.md shows a financial report with tables and metrics — this is the target content type. The .docx templates in Папка/ and Форматы/ are binary reference files for the official document format.
data.for_successor: Any specialist working on DocxGen features (backend engineer, frontend engineer, test engineer) should reference: (1) the spec/ examples for understanding document structure and formality levels, (2) packages/backend/src/prompts.ts for the AI prompt that drives Typst generation, (3) README.md for the full pipeline architecture. The spec examples demonstrate the SYSTEM must handle structured-field Russian business documents with varying formality levels.
